import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { connection } from "next/server";
import AutoRefresh from "@/components/AutoRefresh";
import { listWindow } from "@/lib/fr";
import { loadLabels, loadRun } from "@/lib/store";
import type { ActionItem, Tier } from "@/lib/types";

const TIER_STYLE: Record<Tier, string> = {
  Critical: "border-red-500 text-red-600",
  High: "border-orange-400 text-orange-600",
  Medium: "border-yellow-500 text-yellow-700",
  Low: "border-line text-muted",
};

function Item({ i, label }: { i: ActionItem; label?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className="box p-3 flex flex-col gap-1">
      <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
        <span className={`tag ${TIER_STYLE[i.tier]}`}>{i.tier}</span>
        <a className="font-medium underline-offset-2 hover:underline" href={i.url} target="_blank">{i.title}</a>
        <span className="tag ml-auto">{i.sourceTag}</span>
        {label !== undefined && <span className={`tag ${label ? "border-green-600 text-green-700" : "border-red-500 text-red-600"}`}>{label ? "TP" : "FP"}</span>}
      </div>
      <div className="text-sm">{i.action}</div>
      <div className="text-xs text-muted flex flex-wrap gap-x-4">
        <span>Deadline: {i.deadline ? `${i.deadline.date} · ${i.deadline.kind} · ${i.deadline.verified ? "✓ verified" : "✗ unverified"}` : "none"}</span>
        <span>Owner: {i.owner.name}</span>
        <span>Areas: {i.areas.join(", ") || "—"}</span>
        <span>{i.type} · {i.agencies.join("; ")}</span>
        <span>{i.citation ?? i.document_number} {i.citationVerified ? "✓" : "✗"}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="text-xs text-muted">Why: {i.reason} · Tier rule: {i.tierReason}</div>
      {i.deadlines.length > 0 && (
        <details className="text-xs text-muted">
          <summary>dates checked ({i.deadlines.length})</summary>
          <ul className="pl-4 list-disc">
            {i.deadlines.map((d, k) => (
              <li key={k}>{d.date} {d.kind} [{d.source}] {d.verified ? "✓" : "✗"} — {d.verifyNote}{d.quote ? ` — “${d.quote}”` : ""}</li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </details>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default async function RunPage({ params }: PageProps<"/runs/[id]">) {
  await connection();
  const { id } = await params;
  const run = await loadRun(id);
  if (!run) notFound();
  const c = run.config;
  const labels = await loadLabels(c.profileId, c.windowStart, c.windowEnd);
  const truth = labels ? new Set(labels.relevant) : null;
  const docs = new Map((await listWindow(c.windowStart, c.windowEnd)).map((d) => [d.document_number, d]));
  const decisions = [...(run.decisions ?? [])].sort((a, b) => (b.jevProbability ?? (b.llm?.relevant ? 1 : 0)) - (a.jevProbability ?? (a.llm?.relevant ? 1 : 0)));

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <AutoRefresh active={run.status === "running"} />
      <section className="flex flex-col gap-1">
        <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold">{c.mode === "pipeline" ? "Pipeline" : "Baseline"} run · <span className="font-mono text-sm">{run.id}</span></h1>
        <div className="text-sm text-muted">
          {c.profileId} · {c.windowStart} → {c.windowEnd} · as-of {c.asOf} · {c.model}
          {c.mode === "pipeline" && ` · filter ${c.filter}${c.filter !== "llm" ? ` @ ${c.jevThreshold}` : ""} · web leads ${c.webLeads ? "on" : "off"}`}
          {c.group && ` · group ${c.group}`}
        </div>
        <div className="text-sm">
          Status <b>{run.status}</b>{run.error && <span className="text-red-600"> — {run.error}</span>} · ${run.totalCostUsd.toFixed(4)} · {(run.totalMs / 1000).toFixed(1)}s
          {!truth && <span className="text-muted"> · no labels yet for this window (TP/FP hidden)</span>}
        </div>
      </section>

      <section>
        <h2 className="font-semibold mb-2">Stages</h2>
        <div className="box overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="t">
            <thead><tr><th>Stage</th><th>Time</th><th>Cost</th><th>In</th><th>Out</th><th>Note</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {run.stages.map((s, k) => (
                <tr key={k}><td className="font-mono text-xs">{s.name}</td><td>{(s.ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s</td><td className="font-mono text-xs">${s.costUsd.toFixed(4)}</td><td>{s.inCount ?? ""}</td><td>{s.outCount ?? ""}</td><td className="text-muted">{s.note ?? ""}</td></tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section>
        <h2 className="font-semibold mb-2">Action items ({run.items?.length ?? 0})</h2>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {(run.items ?? []).map((i) => <Item key={i.document_number} i={i} label={truth ? truth.has(i.document_number) : undefined} />)}
          {truth && run.status === "done" && [...truth].filter((n) => !run.items?.some((i) => i.document_number === n)).map((n) => (
            <div key={n} className="box p-2 text-sm border-dashed"><span className="tag border-red-500 text-red-600">MISSED</span> {n} — {docs.get(n)?.title}</div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>

      {!!run.dropped?.length && (
        <section>
          <h2 className="font-semibold mb-2">Dropped by verification ({run.dropped.length})</h2>
          <ul className="text-sm list-disc pl-5">{run.dropped.map((d, k) => <li key={k}><span className="font-mono">{d.document_number}</span> — {d.why}</li>)}</ul>
        </section>
      )}

      {!!run.webLeads?.length && (
        <section>
          <details>
            <summary className="font-semibold">Web leads ({run.webLeads.length}, {run.webLeads.filter((w) => w.document_number).length} resolved to FR)</summary>
            <ul className="text-xs list-disc pl-5 mt-2">{run.webLeads.map((w, k) => <li key={k}>{w.document_number ? `✓ ${w.document_number}` : "✗"} <a className="underline" href={w.url} target="_blank">{w.url}</a></li>)}</ul>
          </details>
        </section>
      )}

      {decisions.length > 0 && (
        <section>
          <details>
            <summary className="font-semibold">Filter decisions ({decisions.length} docs; sorted by Jev p)</summary>
            <div className="box overflow-x-auto mt-2 max-h-[520px] overflow-y-auto">
              <table className="t">
                <thead><tr><th>Doc</th><th>Title</th><th>Jev p</th><th>LLM</th><th>Final</th>{truth && <th>Label</th>}</tr></thead>
                <tbody>
                  {decisions.map((d) => (
                    <tr key={d.document_number}>
                      <td className="font-mono text-xs">{d.document_number}</td>
                      <td className="text-xs">{docs.get(d.document_number)?.title.slice(0, 110)}{d.llm?.reason && <div className="text-muted">{d.llm.reason}</div>}</td>
                      <td className="font-mono text-xs">{d.jevProbability?.toFixed(2) ?? "—"}</td>
                      <td>{d.llm ? (d.llm.relevant ? "yes" : "no") : "—"}</td>
                      <td>{d.relevant ? "✓" : ""}</td>
                      {truth && <td>{truth.has(d.document_number) ? "relevant" : ""}</td>}
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </details>
        </section>
      )}

      <section>
        <details>
          <summary className="font-semibold">Transcript ({run.calls.length} model calls)</summary>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 mt-2">
            {run.calls.map((call, k) => (
              <details key={k} className="box p-2 text-xs">
                <summary className="font-mono">{call.stage} · {call.model} · {(call.ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s · ${call.costUsd.toFixed(4)} · in {call.inputTokens ?? "?"} / out {call.outputTokens ?? "?"}{call.toolCalls ? ` · ${call.toolCalls.length} tool calls` : ""}{call.error ? " · ERROR" : ""}</summary>
                {call.error && <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-red-600">{call.error}</pre>}
                {call.prompt && <><div className="text-muted mt-2">prompt</div><pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap max-h-64 overflow-auto">{call.prompt}</pre></>}
                {call.toolCalls && <><div className="text-muted mt-2">tool calls</div><pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap max-h-64 overflow-auto">{JSON.stringify(call.toolCalls.map((t) => ({ name: t.name, input: t.input })), null, 2)}</pre></>}
                <div className="text-muted mt-2">output</div>
                <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap max-h-64 overflow-auto">{typeof call.output === "string" ? call.output : JSON.stringify(call.output, null, 2)}</pre>
              </details>
            ))}
          </div>
        </details>
      </section>

      {run.markdown && (
        <section>
          <details>
            <summary className="font-semibold">report.md</summary>
            <pre className="box p-3 text-xs whitespace-pre-wrap mt-2">{run.markdown}</pre>
          </details>
        </section>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { FrDoc, LabelSet } from "@/lib/types";

const groupKey = (d: FrDoc) => d.agencies[0]?.name ?? d.agencies[0]?.raw_name ?? "Unknown agency";

/**
 * Ground truth is the user's call — this page never shows model output (no Jev scores, no LLM verdicts),
 * so labels can't be anchored on the system being graded.
 */
export default function LabelBoard({ profileId, start, end }: { profileId: string; start: string; end: string }) {
  const [docs, setDocs] = useState<FrDoc[]>([]);
  const [rel, setRel] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [reviewed, setReviewed] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  const [hideReviewed, setHideReviewed] = useState(false);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState<string>("");
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch(`/api/labels?profile=${profileId}&start=${start}&end=${end}`)
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then(({ docs, labels }: { docs: FrDoc[]; labels: LabelSet | null }) => {
        setDocs(docs);
        if (labels) {
          setRel(new Set(labels.relevant));
          setReviewed(new Set(labels.reviewedAgencies));
          setNotes(labels.notes ?? {});
        }
      });
  }, [profileId, start, end]);

  const groups = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, FrDoc[]>();
    for (const d of docs) {
      const s = `${d.title} ${d.abstract ?? ""} ${d.document_number} ${groupKey(d)}`.toLowerCase();
      if (q && !s.includes(q.toLowerCase())) continue;
      const k = groupKey(d);
      m.set(k, [...(m.get(k) ?? []), d]);
    }
    return [...m.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
  }, [docs, q]);

  const allGroups = useMemo(() => new Set(docs.map(groupKey)), [docs]);

  async function save() {
    const body: LabelSet = { profileId, windowStart: start, windowEnd: end, relevant: [...rel], reviewedAgencies: [...reviewed], notes, updatedAt: "" };
    await fetch("/api/labels", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body) });
    setSaved(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
  }

  const toggle = <T,>(s: Set<T>, v: T) => {
    const n = new Set(s);
    if (n.has(v)) n.delete(v);
    else n.add(v);
    return n;
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <div className="box p-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm sticky top-0 z-10">
        <b>{rel.size}</b> relevant · <b>{reviewed.size}</b>/{allGroups.size} agencies reviewed · {docs.length} docs
        <input className="inp" placeholder="search title/abstract/agency" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} />
        <label className="flex items-center gap-1"><input type="checkbox" checked={hideReviewed} onChange={(e) => setHideReviewed(e.target.checked)} /> hide reviewed</label>
        <span className="ml-auto text-muted text-xs">{saved && `saved ${saved}`}</span>
        <button className="btn" onClick={save}>Save labels</button>
      </div>
      {groups
        .filter(([g]) => !(hideReviewed && reviewed.has(g)))
        .map(([g, ds]) => (
          <div key={g} className="box">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 border-b border-line text-sm">
              <b>{g}</b> <span className="text-muted">{ds.length} docs · {ds.filter((d) => rel.has(d.document_number)).length} relevant</span>
              <label className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1 text-xs"><input type="checkbox" checked={reviewed.has(g)} onChange={() => setReviewed((s) => toggle(s, g))} /> reviewed every doc in this agency</label>
            </div>
            <table className="t">
              <tbody>
                {ds.map((d) => (
                  <tr key={d.document_number} className={rel.has(d.document_number) ? "bg-green-500/10" : ""}>
                    <td className="w-8"><input type="checkbox" checked={rel.has(d.document_number)} onChange={() => setRel((s) => toggle(s, d.document_number))} /></td>
                    <td className="font-mono text-xs w-28">{d.document_number}</td>
                    <td className="text-xs w-24">{d.type}</td>
                    <td className="text-xs">
                      <button className="text-left hover:underline" onClick={() => setOpen(open === d.document_number ? null : d.document_number)}>{d.title}</button>
                      {open === d.document_number && (
                        <div className="mt-1 text-muted flex flex-col gap-1">
                          <div>{d.abstract ?? "(no abstract)"}</div>
                          <div>Dates: {d.dates ?? "—"} · effective {d.effective_on ?? "—"} · comments close {d.comments_close_on ?? "—"}</div>
                          <a className="underline" href={d.html_url} target="_blank">open on federalregister.gov</a>
                          <input className="inp" placeholder="note (why relevant / not)" value={notes[d.document_number] ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setNotes((n) => ({ ...n, [d.document_number]: e.target.value }))} />
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export default async function LabelPage({ searchParams }: PageProps<"/label">) {

        <summary className="font-medium">Company profile</summary>
        <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-xs mt-2">{profileBrief(getProfile(profileId))}</pre>

      <LabelBoard profileId={profileId} start={start} end={end} />
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { connection } from "next/server";
import { listWindow } from "@/lib/fr";
import { consistency, jevSweep, scoreRun } from "@/lib/score";
import { listRuns, loadLabels } from "@/lib/store";

const TARGET = { recall: 0.9, precision: 0.8, relAgree: 0.9 };
const pct = (x: number) => `${(x * 100).toFixed(0)}%`;
const mark = (ok: boolean) => (ok ? <span className="text-green-700">✓</span> : <span className="text-red-600">✗</span>);

export default async function EvalsPage({ searchParams }: PageProps<"/evals">) {
  await connection();
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const profileId = (sp.profile as string) ?? "ledgerly";
  const start = (sp.start as string) ?? "2026-11-09";
  const end = (sp.end as string) ?? "2026-11-13";

  const [labels, docs, all] = await Promise.all([loadLabels(profileId, start, end), listWindow(start, end), listRuns()]);
  const runs = all.filter((r) => r.status === "done" && r.config.profileId === profileId && r.config.windowStart === start && r.config.windowEnd === end);
  const agencies = new Set(docs.map((d) => d.agencies[0]?.name ?? "Unknown agency"));

  if (!labels || labels.relevant.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="box p-4 text-sm">
        No ground truth yet for {profileId} · {start} → {end}. <Link className="underline" href="/label">Label the week first</Link> — every metric here is set math against your labels.
      </div>
    );
  }

  const scored = runs.map((r) => ({ r, s: scoreRun(r, labels) }));
  const groups = new Map<string, typeof runs>();
  for (const r of runs) if (r.config.group) groups.set(r.config.group, [...(groups.get(r.config.group) ?? []), r]);
  const jevRun = runs.find((r) => r.decisions?.some((d) => d.jevProbability !== undefined) && (r.config.filter === "jev" || r.config.jevThreshold <= 0.1)) ?? runs.find((r) => r.decisions?.some((d) => d.jevProbability !== undefined));

  // Average per config: the pipeline-vs-baseline headline.
  const byCfg = new Map<string, typeof scored>();
  for (const x of scored) {
    const c = x.r.config;
    const k = `${c.mode} · ${c.model.split("/")[1]}${c.mode === "pipeline" ? ` · ${c.filter}${c.filter !== "llm" ? `@${c.jevThreshold}` : ""}` : ""}`;
    byCfg.set(k, [...(byCfg.get(k) ?? []), x]);
  }
  const avg = (xs: number[]) => xs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / (xs.length || 1);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <section>
        <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold">Evals · {profileId} · {start} → {end}</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted">
          Ground truth: {labels.relevant.length} relevant docs of {docs.length} · {labels.reviewedAgencies.length}/{agencies.size} agencies reviewed
          {labels.reviewedAgencies.length < agencies.size && " (recall is only honest once every agency is reviewed)"}. Graders are code: recall/precision on document numbers, dates checked against the Federal Register record, tier agreement across repeats.
        </p>
      </section>

      <section>
        <h2 className="font-semibold mb-2">Headline: harness vs baseline (mean over runs)</h2>
        <div className="box overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="t">
            <thead><tr><th>Config</th><th>Runs</th><th>Recall ≥ .9</th><th>Precision ≥ .8</th><th>Dates verified</th><th>Unresolved claims</th><th>$ / run</th><th>s / run</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {[...byCfg.entries()].map(([k, xs]) => {
                const rec = avg(xs.map((x) => x.s.recall));
                const pre = avg(xs.map((x) => x.s.precision));
                const shown = xs.reduce((a, x) => a + x.s.datesShown, 0);
                const ver = xs.reduce((a, x) => a + x.s.datesVerified, 0);
                return (
                  <tr key={k}>
                    <td className="font-mono text-xs">{k}</td>
                    <td>{xs.length}</td>
                    <td>{pct(rec)} {mark(rec >= TARGET.recall)}</td>
                    <td>{pct(pre)} {mark(pre >= TARGET.precision)}</td>
                    <td>{shown ? `${ver}/${shown}` : "—"} {shown ? mark(ver === shown) : ""}</td>
                    <td>{avg(xs.map((x) => x.s.unresolved)).toFixed(1)}</td>
                    <td className="font-mono text-xs">${avg(xs.map((x) => x.s.costUsd)).toFixed(3)}</td>
                    <td className="font-mono text-xs">{(avg(xs.map((x) => x.s.ms)) / 1000).toFixed(0)}s {avg(xs.map((x) => x.s.ms)) > 300_000 && <span className="text-red-600">&gt; 300s cap</span>}</td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section>
        <h2 className="font-semibold mb-2">Consistency (repeat groups)</h2>
        {groups.size === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted">Run any config with &quot;Repeat: 3 runs&quot; to measure it.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="box overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="t">
              <thead><tr><th>Group</th><th>Config</th><th>Runs</th><th>Relevance agreement ≥ 90%</th><th>Tier identical</th><th>Disagreed on</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                {[...groups.entries()].map(([g, rs]) => {
                  const c = consistency(rs);
                  return (
                    <tr key={g}>
                      <td className="font-mono text-xs">{g}</td>
                      <td className="font-mono text-xs">{rs[0].config.mode} · {rs[0].config.model.split("/")[1]}</td>
                      <td>{c.runs}</td>
                      <td>{pct(c.relevanceAgreement)} {mark(c.relevanceAgreement >= TARGET.relAgree)}</td>
                      <td>{pct(c.tierAgreement)} {mark(c.tierAgreement === 1)}</td>
                      <td className="font-mono text-xs">{c.disagreements.join(", ")}</td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      {jevRun && (
        <section>
          <h2 className="font-semibold mb-2">Jev prefilter threshold sweep <span className="text-xs text-muted font-normal">(from <Link className="underline" href={`/runs/${jevRun.id}`}>{jevRun.id.slice(0, 19)}</Link>)</span></h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted mb-2">Jev answers with a probability only. The question is the lowest-cost cut that keeps recall: everything at or above the threshold goes to the LLM.</p>
          <div className="box overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="t">
              <thead><tr><th>Threshold</th><th>Docs passed to LLM</th><th>Prefilter recall</th><th>Prefilter precision</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                {jevSweep(jevRun, labels).map((row) => (
                  <tr key={row.threshold}><td>{row.threshold}</td><td>{row.passed}</td><td>{pct(row.recall)} {mark(row.recall >= TARGET.recall)}</td><td>{pct(row.precision)}</td></tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      <section>
        <h2 className="font-semibold mb-2">Every run</h2>
        <div className="box overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="t">
            <thead><tr><th>Run</th><th>Mode</th><th>TP</th><th>FP</th><th>FN</th><th>Recall</th><th>Precision</th><th>Missed</th><th>Extra</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {scored.map(({ r, s }) => (
                <tr key={r.id}>
                  <td className="font-mono text-xs"><Link className="underline" href={`/runs/${r.id}`}>{r.id.slice(0, 19)}</Link></td>
                  <td>{r.config.mode}</td>
                  <td>{s.tp}</td><td>{s.fp}</td><td>{s.fn}</td>
                  <td>{pct(s.recall)}</td><td>{pct(s.precision)}</td>
                  <td className="font-mono text-xs">{s.missed.join(", ")}</td>
                  <td className="font-mono text-xs">{s.extra.join(", ")}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
EOF

# vitest-evals
Harness-backed AI testing on top of Vitest.
Use this package README for the core authoring model. For a guided setup path,
runtime-specific harness examples, replay, and GitHub Actions reporting, start
with the docs site: `https://vitest-evals.sentry.dev/docs`.
## Install
```sh
npm install -D vitest-evals
```
Install a first-party harness package for the runtime you want to test:
```sh
npm install -D @vitest-evals/harness-pi-ai
# or
npm install -D @vitest-evals/harness-ai-sdk
# or
npm install -D @vitest-evals/harness-openai-agents
```
For GitHub Actions summaries and annotations, emit Vitest JSON and use the
native `getsentry/vitest-evals` action. No extra npm package is needed in the
workflow.
## Core Model
- `describeEval(...)` binds exactly one harness to a suite
- the suite callback receives a fixture-backed Vitest `it`
- `run(input)` executes the harness explicitly and returns a normalized
  `HarnessRun`
- the returned `result.output` is the app-facing value you assert on directly
- helper assertions usually read the returned `result`, for example
  `toolCalls(result)` or `assistantMessages(result)`
- `result.session` is the canonical JSON-serializable transcript for reporting,
  replay, tool assertions, and judges
- `result.traces` contains JSON-serializable operation spans; first-party
  harnesses attach native spans when provider/runtime data is available, while
  `createHarness(...)` attaches a fallback run span for custom harnesses that do
  not return traces themselves. Span attributes include typed
  OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic keys while still allowing provider-specific
  metadata
- scenario-specific judge criteria should live in `input` or explicit matcher
  options, depending on whether the app or only the judge needs them
- suite-level `judges` are optional and run automatically after each `run(...)`
- suite-level `judgeThreshold` controls fail-on-score for those automatic judges
- every judge is a named object with `assess(ctx)`
- every judge receives `JudgeContext` with typed `input`, typed `output`, the
  normalized run/session, and tool calls; `output` is only optional
  when the harness output type includes `undefined`
- judges own their prompt, rubric, and parsing; LLM-backed judges use
  `ctx.runJudge(...)` from a configured `judgeHarness`
- explicit judge assertions use
  `await expect(result).toSatisfyJudge(judge, options)`
## Explicit Run Example
```ts
import { getModel } from "@mariozechner/pi-ai";
import { expect } from "vitest";
import { piAiHarness, piAiJudgeHarness } from "@vitest-evals/harness-pi-ai";
import {
  describeEval,
  FactualityJudge,
  toolCalls,
} from "vitest-evals";
import { createRefundAgent } from "../src/refundAgent";
const judgeHarness = piAiJudgeHarness({
  model: getModel("anthropic", "claude-sonnet-4-5"),
  temperature: 0,
});
describeEval(
  "refund agent",
  {
    harness: piAiHarness({
      agent: () => createRefundAgent(),
    }),
    judgeHarness,
    judges: [
      FactualityJudge({
        expected: "The refund request is approved.",
      }),
    ],
    judgeThreshold: 0.6,
  },
  (it) => {
    it("approves a refundable invoice", async ({ run }) => {
      const result = await run("Refund invoice inv_123");
      expect(result.output).toMatchObject({ status: "approved" });
      expect(toolCalls(result).map((call) => call.name)).toEqual([
        "lookupInvoice",
        "createRefund",
      ]);
    });
  },
);
```
## Table-Driven Vitest Style
If you want case tables, use Vitest's own `it.for(...)` and call `run(...)`
inside the test body:
```ts
describeEval("refund agent", { harness }, (it) => {
  it.for([
    {
      name: "approves refundable invoice",
      input: "Refund invoice inv_123",
      expectedStatus: "approved",
    },
    {
      name: "denies non-refundable invoice",
      input: "Refund invoice inv_404",
      expectedStatus: "denied",
    },
  ])("$name", async ({ input, expectedStatus }, { run }) => {
    const result = await run(input);
    expect(result.output).toMatchObject({
      status: expectedStatus,
    });
  });
});
```
## Terminal Reporting
The terminal reporter has two eval report levels. Normal mode prints compact
test and score summaries, with application and judge tokens and cost shown
separately. Info mode adds per-tool summaries,
arguments, timing/size metadata, replay status, and final output summaries.
Set `VITEST_EVALS_REPORT_LEVEL=info`, or pass `--info` through the workspace
eval scripts, to enable it. `--verbose` and `-v` remain aliases for
compatibility.
Full transcripts and spans are preserved in the Vitest JSON report metadata.
## Local Report UI
The local report UI reads the same Vitest JSON artifacts and serves a React SPA
for drilling into runs, eval cases, harness output, sessions, tool calls,
scores, trace spans, and separate application, judge, and total usage.
```sh
pnpm exec vitest-evals serve vitest-results.json
pnpm exec vitest-evals serve "eval-results/*.json"
pnpm exec vitest-evals serve eval-results/
```
## GitHub Actions Reporting
Use Vitest JSON as the eval report artifact. It preserves the `meta` field that
contains eval scores and normalized harness runs.
```sh
vitest run --config vitest.evals.config.ts \
  --reporter=vitest-evals/reporter \
  --reporter=json \
  --outputFile.json=vitest-results.json
```
```yaml
- uses: getsentry/vitest-evals@v0
  if: always()
  with:
    results: vitest-results.json
```
The GitHub reporter action writes a job summary, emits short failure
annotations, can publish a separate Check Run, and can reduce sharded eval JSON
artifacts into one combined report.

import { Harness } from '../harness.js';
import { RunJudge, JudgeHarness } from './judgeHarness.js';
import { JsonValue, ToolCall, HarnessRun } from '@vitest-evals/core';
/**
 * Score payload returned by a judge.
 *
 * @example
 * ```ts
 * const result: JudgeResult = {
 *   score: 1,
 *   metadata: {
 *     rationale: "Output matched the expected refund status.",
 *   },
 * };
 * ```
 */
type JudgeResult = {
    /** Numeric score. `null` records an intentionally unscored result. */
    score: number | null;
    /** JSON-like judge metadata shown by assertions and reporters. */
    metadata?: {
        /** Human-readable explanation for the score. */
        rationale?: string;
        /** Optional judge-side output or diagnostic payload. */
        output?: JsonValue;
    } & Record<string, JsonValue | undefined>;
};
/**
 * Full normalized context passed to every judge.
 *
 * @example
 * ```ts
 * type RefundOutput = { status: "approved" | "denied" };
 *
 * const RefundStatusJudge = createJudge<string, RefundOutput>(
 *   "RefundStatusJudge",
 *   ({ output }) => ({
 *     score: output.status === "approved" ? 1 : 0,
 *   }),
 * );
 * ```
 */
interface JudgeContext<TInput = any, TOutput extends JsonValue | undefined = JsonValue | undefined, THarness extends Harness<TInput, TOutput> | undefined = Harness<TInput, TOutput> | undefined> {
    /** Original eval input passed to the harness. */
    input: TInput;
    /** App-facing output returned by the harness. */
    output: TOutput;
    /** Flattened tool calls observed in the normalized session. */
    toolCalls: ToolCall[];
    /** Complete normalized harness run being judged. */
    run: HarnessRun<TOutput>;
    /** Normalized transcript associated with the harness run. */
    session: HarnessRun<TOutput>["session"];
    /** Harness associated with this judge context. */
    harness: THarness;
    /** Runs the configured matcher, judge, or suite judge harness with run-scoped context. */
    runJudge?: RunJudge;
}
/** Convenience helper for judges that accept explicit per-call params. */
type JudgeOptions<TInput = any, TOutput extends JsonValue | undefined = JsonValue | undefined, TParams extends object = Record<never, never>, THarness extends Harness<TInput, TOutput> | undefined = Harness<TInput, TOutput> | undefined> = JudgeContext<TInput, TOutput, THarness> & TParams;
/** Function that assesses a normalized judge context. */
type JudgeAssessFn<TOptions extends JudgeContext<any, any, any> = JudgeContext> = (opts: TOptions) => Promise<JudgeResult> | JudgeResult;
/**
 * Runtime options supplied by core when calling a legacy judge-side assessor.
 *
 * @deprecated Prefer `RunJudgeOptions` with `ctx.runJudge(...)`.
 */
type JudgeAssessorOptions = {
    /** Abort signal from the current eval run when available. */
    signal?: AbortSignal;
};
/**
 * Legacy provider/model helper that a judge can use without running the app
 * harness.
 *
 * New LLM-backed judges should use `createJudgeHarness(...)` plus
 * `ctx.runJudge(...)` instead. The judge harness path supports response
 * formats, matcher/suite/judge-level configuration, and keeps provider
 * adapters outside core judge implementations.
 *
123:    usage?: UsageSummary;

import { defineConfig } from "vitest/config";
import path from "node:path";

// Separate from unit tests: evals spend money and take minutes.
export default defineConfig({
  resolve: { alias: { "@": path.resolve(__dirname, "src") } },
  test: { include: ["evals/**/*.eval.ts"], testTimeout: 600_000, hookTimeout: 600_000, fileParallelism: false },

cat > evals/triage.eval.ts <<'EOF'
/**
 * Experiment 2 — what our evals look like.
 *
 * Following Anthropic's "Demystifying evals for AI agents":
 *  - grade the OUTCOME with code where possible (recall/precision on FR document numbers,
 *    dates checked against the primary source),
 *  - grade the TRANSCRIPT as a secondary signal (did it ground on federalregister.gov?),
 *  - use an LLM judge only where code can't (is the action item usable?).
 *
 * EVAL_MODE=replay  → grade the latest saved run per case (free, regression-style).
 * EVAL_MODE=live    → execute fresh runs (spends money; capability-style). Default: replay.
 */
import { generateText, Output } from "ai";
import { expect } from "vitest";
import { createHarness, createJudge, describeEval } from "vitest-evals";
import { z } from "zod";
import { gw } from "../src/lib/gateway";
import { execute, newRun } from "../src/lib/pipeline/run";
import { scoreRun } from "../src/lib/score";
import { listRuns, loadLabels } from "../src/lib/store";
import type { RunConfig, RunRecord } from "../src/lib/types";

const WINDOW = { profileId: "ledgerly", windowStart: "2026-11-09", windowEnd: "2026-11-13", asOf: "2026-11-13" };
const MODEL = process.env.EVAL_MODEL ?? "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5";
const LIVE = process.env.EVAL_MODE === "live";

type CaseInput = { name: string; config: RunConfig };
type CaseOutput = {
  runId: string;
  recall: number;
  precision: number;
  tp: number;
  fp: number;
  fn: number;
  missed: string[];
  extra: string[];
  datesShown: number;
  datesVerified: number;
  unresolved: number;
  costUsd: number;
  seconds: number;
  items: { document_number: string; tier: string; owner: string; action: string; reason: string; sourceTag: string }[];
  groundedOnFR: boolean;
};

const CASES: CaseInput[] = [
  { name: "pipeline · jev@0.1 → llm", config: { ...WINDOW, mode: "pipeline", model: MODEL, filter: "jev+llm", jevThreshold: 0.1, webLeads: false } },
  { name: "pipeline · llm on every doc", config: { ...WINDOW, mode: "pipeline", model: MODEL, filter: "llm", jevThreshold: 0, webLeads: false } },
  { name: "baseline · one prompt + native search", config: { ...WINDOW, mode: "baseline", model: MODEL, filter: "llm", jevThreshold: 0, webLeads: false } },
];

const sameCfg = (a: RunConfig, b: RunConfig) =>
  a.mode === b.mode && a.model === b.model && a.windowStart === b.windowStart && a.windowEnd === b.windowEnd &&
  (a.mode === "baseline" || (a.filter === b.filter && (a.filter === "llm" || a.jevThreshold === b.jevThreshold)));

async function getRun(cfg: RunConfig): Promise<RunRecord | null> {
  if (LIVE) return execute(newRun(cfg));
  return (await listRuns()).find((r) => r.status === "done" && sameCfg(r.config, cfg)) ?? null;
}

const harness = createHarness<CaseInput, CaseOutput>({
  name: "reg-monitor",
  run: async ({ input }) => {
    const labels = await loadLabels(WINDOW.profileId, WINDOW.windowStart, WINDOW.windowEnd);
    if (!labels?.relevant.length) throw new Error("No labels — label the week at /label first.");
    const run = await getRun(input.config);
    if (!run) throw new Error(`No saved run for "${input.name}" — run it from the UI or set EVAL_MODE=live.`);
    const s = scoreRun(run, labels);
    const items = (run.items ?? []).map((i) => ({ document_number: i.document_number, tier: i.tier, owner: i.owner.name, action: i.action, reason: i.reason, sourceTag: i.sourceTag }));
    // Transcript check: pipeline grounds on the FR API by construction; baseline must have searched AND every kept item resolved to FR.
    const searched = run.calls.some((c) => c.toolCalls?.some((t) => /search/i.test(t.name))) || run.config.mode === "pipeline";
    const output: CaseOutput = {
      runId: run.id,
      recall: s.recall,
      precision: s.precision,
      tp: s.tp,
      fp: s.fp,
      fn: s.fn,
      missed: s.missed,
      extra: s.extra,
      datesShown: s.datesShown,
      datesVerified: s.datesVerified,
      unresolved: s.unresolved,
      costUsd: run.totalCostUsd,
      seconds: run.totalMs / 1000,
      items,
      groundedOnFR: searched && run.stages.some((st) => st.name.startsWith("scan:federal-register") || st.name.includes("resolve")),
    };
    return {
      events: [
        { type: "message", role: "user", content: `${input.name} (${run.id})` },
        ...run.calls.flatMap((c, k) => [
          ...(c.toolCalls ?? []).map((t, j) => ({ type: "tool_call" as const, id: `${k}-${j}`, name: t.name, arguments: (t.input ?? {}) as Record<string, never> })),
        ]),
        { type: "message", role: "assistant", content: run.markdown ?? "" },
      ],
      output,
      usage: {},
    };
  },
});

// ── Code graders ──
const RecallJudge = createJudge<CaseInput, CaseOutput>("Recall ≥ 0.9", ({ output }) => ({ score: output.recall, metadata: { rationale: `tp ${output.tp} / fn ${output.fn}; missed ${output.missed.join(", ") || "none"}` } }));
const PrecisionJudge = createJudge<CaseInput, CaseOutput>("Precision ≥ 0.8", ({ output }) => ({ score: output.precision, metadata: { rationale: `tp ${output.tp} / fp ${output.fp}; extra ${output.extra.join(", ") || "none"}` } }));
const DatesJudge = createJudge<CaseInput, CaseOutput>("Dates verified = 100%", ({ output }) => ({
  score: output.datesShown ? output.datesVerified / output.datesShown : 1,
  metadata: { rationale: `${output.datesVerified}/${output.datesShown} shown deadlines match the Federal Register record` },
}));

// ── Model grader (only where code can't): is each action item forwardable? ──
const ActionQualityJudge = createJudge<CaseInput, CaseOutput>("Action items usable (LLM judge)", async ({ output }) => {
  if (!output.items.length) return { score: 0, metadata: { rationale: "no items" } };
  const r = await generateText({
    model: gw("anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5"),
    output: Output.object({ schema: z.object({ scores: z.array(z.object({ document_number: z.string(), score: z.number().min(0).max(1), why: z.string() })) }) }),
    prompt: `You grade action items a GC would forward to an owner. Score each 0..1: 1 = names a concrete next step, the owner is plausible for the topic, and the reason is specific to the company; 0.5 = vague but not wrong; 0 = wrong owner, generic, or asserts facts not supported by the reason.\n\n${JSON.stringify(output.items, null, 1)}`,
  });
  const scores = r.output.scores;
  const mean = scores.reduce((a, s) => a + s.score, 0) / (scores.length || 1);
  return { score: mean, metadata: { rationale: scores.map((s) => `${s.document_number}: ${s.score} ${s.why}`).join(" | ") } };
});

describeEval(
  "regulatory triage · ledgerly · week of 2026-11-09",
  { harness, judges: [RecallJudge, PrecisionJudge, DatesJudge, ActionQualityJudge], judgeThreshold: null },
  (it) => {
    it.for(CASES)("$name", async (c, { run }) => {
      const result = await run(c);
      const o = result.output;
      console.log(`${c.name}: recall ${o.recall.toFixed(2)} precision ${o.precision.toFixed(2)} dates ${o.datesVerified}/${o.datesShown} unresolved ${o.unresolved} $${o.costUsd.toFixed(3)} ${o.seconds.toFixed(0)}s`);
      // Hard gates from the RFC. Expected to FAIL for the baseline — that's the comparison.
      expect.soft(o.recall, "recall").toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0.9);
      expect.soft(o.precision, "precision").toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0.8);
      expect.soft(o.datesVerified, "every shown date verified").toBe(o.datesShown);
      expect.soft(o.groundedOnFR, "grounded on federalregister.gov").toBe(true);
    });
  },
);
EOF

/Users/anfal/Projects/hobby_projects/gc-ai-swe-take-home/poc/README.md
# Regulatory Monitoring — POC (reference only)

Scrappy proof of concept that validates the RFC before the real build. Lives on the `poc`
branch and is never merged. The real build cites what this proves.

Three questions it answers:

1. **Does the workflow work?** Config → Scan (Federal Register API + optional Exa leads) →
   Filter (Jev decision model and/or LLM) → Verify + Tier (code) → Output (LLM).
2. **What do the evals look like?** Code graders on the outcome, transcript checks as a
   secondary signal, an LLM judge only for action-item quality (`evals/triage.eval.ts`).
3. **Does it beat a baseline?** One prompt + the same model's native web search, graded by the
   same code.

## Run it

```bash
pnpm install
# key is read from ../.env (VERCEL_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY)
pnpm dev                 # http://localhost:3000 — Run · Label · Evals
pnpm test                # unit tests: tier rules, date verification, scoring
pnpm run run -- --filter jev+llm --threshold 0.1 --runs 3 --group my-group   # CLI run
pnpm evals               # grade saved runs against your labels (free)
EVAL_MODE=live pnpm evals  # execute fresh runs, then grade (spends money)
pnpm evals:json && pnpm evals:ui   # vitest-evals report viewer
```

Spend is capped at $15 total (`POC_BUDGET_USD`). It is the sum of every saved run's
Gateway-reported cost, and runs refuse to start past it.

## Where things are

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `src/lib/pipeline/stages.ts` | scan, web leads, Jev/LLM filter, verify + tier, output |
| `src/lib/pipeline/run.ts` | pipeline orchestration + baseline |
| `src/lib/tier.ts` | deterministic tiering (tested) |
| `src/lib/verify.ts` | quote-based date verification, FR URL → doc number (tested) |
| `src/lib/score.ts` | recall/precision, consistency, Jev threshold sweep (tested) |
| `evals/triage.eval.ts` | vitest-evals suite: 3 configs × code graders + LLM judge |
| `data/runs/*.json` | every run: config, stages, full model transcript, items, cost |
| `data/labels/*.json` | hand labels (ground truth) — written by the Label page |

## Findings so far (week 2026-11-09 → 13, Ledgerly profile, Sonnet 5.5)

- **Data:** 448 docs/week, ~54K tokens of title+abstract. One week fits in one context;
  Brian's 5M-token concern doesn't arise at weekly scale.
- **Structured dates:** 46/54 rules have `effective_on` and 32/36 proposed rules have
  `comments_close_on`. The rest live in prose, so dates are extracted with a verbatim quote and
  code checks the quote against the source text.
- **Jev (`typesafe-ai/jev`):** ~$0.014 per 448 docs, ~13s at concurrency 16. Scores are
  bimodal: 432/448 below 0.2.
- **Batch effect:** with the LLM judging every doc in batches of 20, the OFAC general licenses
  were dropped. Behind the Jev prefilter they were kept. Batch makeup changes verdicts.
- **Web leads (Exa):** 24 URLs, 0 new Federal Register documents (mostly secondary news). The
  exhaustive API scan makes web leads redundant for federal scope.
- **Baseline:** the same 2 items in 3/3 runs, $0.47–0.66/run, ~20s. **Pipeline:**
  $0.09–0.13/run, ~33s, 6–7 items, tiers identical across 3 runs.
- **Recall/precision:** pending hand labels (Label page).
- **Tooling:** `vitest-evals` 0.18 declares a peer of `ai < 7`. The core `createHarness` works
  with AI SDK 7; the `harness-ai-sdk` package was not needed.

I swapped in a made-up food company, Brightside Foods: it makes hot dogs, gummy candy and pecan/apple snack bars, sells in grocery stores, and runs delivery trucks. Same week of rules. On this one the pipeline clearly beat the single-prompt baseline:

Rule this week, in plain English Pipeline ($0.15) Baseline ($0.53)
FDA bans the orange dye used on hot-dog casings ✅ ❌ missed
FDA changes the chemicals allowed when making food colors (2 rules) ✅ deadline Dec 10 ⚠️ said Dec 12
Fewer people would qualify for SNAP (food stamps) ✅ ✅
Stricter work requirements to keep SNAP ✅ ❌ missed
New rules for pecan handlers ✅ ✅
Petition to approve a new insect-resistant corn ✅ (Medium) ❌
  • The baseline got a date wrong. The official record says objections to the food-color rules are due Dec 10; the baseline said Dec 12 on both. Our date check against the official record flagged both as unverified, so they'd never reach the report. That's exactly what "forward without re-checking" is meant to guarantee.
  • The action items read like plain English now, e.g. "Confirm our hot dogs and sausages no longer use Orange B casing color, and reformulate or relabel any remaining products." I also told the output step to spell out acronyms.

This company is much easier to label, so I'd make it the ground truth for the evals. You can label it at http://localhost:3457/label?profile=brightside. It's committed locally on poc, still not pushed.
